source.description: Discovered during .2. Two quality gaps (not correctness): (1) _enrich_item parses detect_changes HUMAN output by line-substring match (item file_path in line) and uses processes=['compare-range'] placeholder — replace with real symbol/process extraction once a concrete gitnexus compare output sample exists (or switch to structured/MCP path). (2) base_ref uses item.get('last_sync_ref') which may be unset -> falls to HEAD^1 (single-commit); ensure scan populates each item's last_sync_ref from the per-service registry field so the full last_sync_ref..HEAD range is used. VALIDATION: with a real multi-commit drift + index, tiers reflect actual symbols/processes; range covers all commits since last_sync_ref.
